phases.name: Workout Structure Support
phases.description: Ensure lap markers and workout intervals are preserved in FIT export

subtasks.title: Add multi-lap support to FIT exporter
subtasks.description: Enhance the FIT exporter to support multiple laps based on workout segments. Currently only writes a single lap - need to support workout intervals as separate laps.
subtasks.notes:
Enhanced FIT exporter to support multiple laps based on workout segments:
- Added LapData struct with from_samples() and from_segment_durations() methods
- Added export_fit_with_laps() for explicit lap boundaries
- Added export_fit_with_segments() for workout segment-based export
- Refactored write_lap to use write_lap_from_data with LapData support
- Updated write_session to support configurable lap count (num_laps field)
- Added 9 comprehensive unit tests for multi-lap functionality
- Exported new public API through recording/mod.rs

subtasks.title: Add workout step markers to FIT export
subtasks.description: If workout_id is present on ride, load workout structure and include interval markers as lap boundaries or event messages in the FIT file.
subtasks.notes:
Added workout structure support to FIT export:
- Added export_fit_with_workout() function that takes an optional Workout and uses its segments as lap boundaries
- Added extract_workout_segment_durations() helper to extract segment durations from a workout
- Added 6 unit tests covering: workout extraction, export with workout, fallback to single-lap when no workout, fallback when empty segments, and header preservation
- Exported new functions through recording/mod.rs

When a ride has a workout_id, callers can load the workout and pass it to export_fit_with_workout() to preserve interval structure in the FIT file.

phases.name: Testing
phases.description: Add comprehensive tests for FIT export functionality

subtasks.title: Create FIT export unit test file
subtasks.description: Create tests/unit/fit_export_test.rs with comprehensive tests for FIT export including header validation, message structure, CRC verification, and data integrity.
subtasks.notes:
Created tests/unit/fit_export_test.rs with comprehensive FIT export tests covering:
- Header validation: size, protocol version, profile version, .FIT signature, CRC fields
- CRC verification: header CRC, file CRC validation, different data produces different CRC
- Data integrity: minimum file size, file size scaling with samples, error on empty samples, large ride handling
- Message structure: definition messages, data messages, ordering
- Timestamp conversion: FIT epoch (1989-12-31) handling
- Cycling dynamics: balance, torque effectiveness, pedal smoothness, power phase data
- LapData computation: from_samples(), from_segment_durations(), averages, max values, edge cases
- Multi-lap export: export_fit_with_laps(), export_fit_with_segments(), fallback behavior
- Workout export: extract_workout_segment_durations(), export_fit_with_workout()
- Edge cases: missing optional fields, max values, zero duration, deterministic output

Added fit_export_test module to tests/unit/mod.rs.

subtasks.title: Add round-trip test (export then parse)
subtasks.description: Create a test that exports a ride to FIT, then parses it back using fitparser crate to verify the exported file is valid and contains expected data.
subtasks.notes: Added 16 comprehensive roundtrip tests that export rides to FIT format and parse them back using the fitparser crate. Tests verify: FIT file parsing, required message types (FileId, Session, Lap, Activity, Record, Event), data fields (power, HR, cadence, timestamps), multi-lap exports, workout exports, cycling dynamics data, and large ride handling (7200 samples).

- test_roundtrip_dynamics_consistency_across_samples: Verifies consistency across 20 samples
